name: Oota Mamoru
source: Secretly in love with his mom and his sister, is not attracted to anyone else. With his father out of town believes this is his chance to make them his. While he plays up being childish is actual more calculating than he lets on to get his way.
translation: 暗恋母亲和妹妹，无法被其他人吸引。父亲不在家时，他认为这是把她们据为己有的机会。他故意装得幼稚，实际上为了达到目的，比表现出来的更加精于算计。
